purpose: Clarify remaining matching mechanisms in AS08; static model/code inspection, no prediction evaluation
hypothesis: Disabling manual IDEA_B/map/Dense still leaves learned transliteration, lookup, rules and metadata matching
fixed_conditions: No model fitting, inference, ZIP creation or upload

metrics.metric_source: No new accuracy measurement; official aggregate score used only for mathematical bound

observations: Manual IDEA_B_WORD_VARS removal does not disable learned_word_map or learned_syl maps
use_train_lookup_default is true in archived model
Official weighting caps non-Hangul contribution at0.3;0.9 cannot be explained by non-Hangul alone
limitations: Saved lookup entry counts are not test hit counts
Path-specific score contribution and actual server fallback execution unmeasured
Multiple asset maps with the same keys are alternative candidates, not independent vocabulary counts
decision: Explain score through retained matching capabilities; do not claim measured route contributions
retained_paths: callsign/name exact lookup with tonnage compatibility
training-derived word and syllable transliteration maps
EN_V3 non-Hangul candidate search and OSA scoring

metric_bound.scope: Mathematical lower bound only; actual language accuracies unmeasured
